brief:
The London Palestine Film Festival returned this year for its 27th edition, continuing its annual showcase of Palestinian cinema since its founding in 1999, according to Al Jazeera English. The festival has established itself as a platform for Palestinian filmmakers to present their work to international audiences.

The event reflects the festival's sustained commitment to bringing Palestinian narratives and perspectives to British audiences through documentary and feature films.
dek: Since 1999, the London Palestine Film Festival has brought Palestinian stories to the big screen.
title: London Palestine Film Festival opens for 27th year
